records.jp: いぇ～い！！<CR>クイーン初討伐、おめでとう！！
records.en_original: Yaaay! Congrats on taking down your first Queen!
records.en: Yaaay! Congrats on taking down your first Queen!

records.jp: 思わず耳を疑っちゃったけど、<CR>本当にみんな、よく頑張ったね～
records.en_original: I honestly couldn't believe what I was hearing, but seriously, everyone—you did amazing!
records.en: I honestly couldn't believe what I was hearing, but seriously, everyone—you did amazing!

records.jp: 特に詩帆は、初めての出撃だったのに<CR>大活躍だったって聞いたよ～
records.en_original: Especially Shiho. I heard you played a big part in your very first battle!
records.en: Especially Shiho. I heard you played a big part in your very first battle!

records.jp: そ、そんな、逆です！！<CR>迷惑ばかりかけちゃって、高岡さんにだって……
records.en_original: N-no, it's the opposite! I just caused trouble for everyone, especially for Yukiko...
records.en: N-no, it's the opposite! I just caused trouble for everyone, especially for Takaoka-san...

records.jp: でも、ケガ治してくれたでしょ？<CR>なら大活躍じゃん
records.en_original: But you healed my injuries, right? That was a huge help.
records.en: But you healed my injuries, right? That was a huge help.

records.jp: あ、ありがとうございます……
records.en_original: Th-thank you so much...
records.en: Th-thank you so much...

records.jp: ……広島校での英雄譚は、誇張ではなかったようだな
records.en_original: I guess the heroic tales from Hiroshima Academy weren't an exaggeration.
records.en: I guess the heroic tales from Hiroshima Academy weren't an exaggeration.

records.jp: お前の下でなら、私も安心して戦えそうだ。<CR>期待しているぞ……リーダー
records.en_original: If I'm fighting under you, I can relax. I'm counting on you...Leader.
records.en: If I'm fighting under you, I can relax. I'm counting on you...Leader.

records.jp: え、えっと……この方たちは……？
records.en_original: Um, who are these people?
records.en: Um, who are these people?

records.jp: そっか、詩帆とお兄ちゃんは初めてだよね。<CR>かんなたちと同じ、特殊部隊の仲間だよ
records.en_original: Oh, right, this is the first time you and big brother are meeting them. They're members of the special ops unit, just like me and the others.
records.en: Oh, right, this is the first time you and Onii-chan are meeting them. They're members of the special ops unit, just like me and the others.

records.jp: そっちの怖い顔してるのが、菜々花。<CR>お兄ちゃんたちと同じ二年生だよ
records.en_original: The one with the scary face over there is Nanaka. She's a second-year, just like you.
records.en: The one with the scary face is Nanaka.<CR>She's a second-year, just like Onii-chan and the others.

records.jp: その隣がアレシア。<CR>アレシアも同じく二年生だね
records.en_original: And next to her is Alesia. She's also a second-year.
records.en: And next to her is Alesia. She's also a second-year.

records.jp: アレシア……さん？<CR>たしか先生が言ってた……
records.en_original: Alesia? I think the teacher mentioned her...
records.en: Alesia? I think the teacher mentioned her...

records.jp: で、最後がきらら。<CR>かんなと同じ一年生で、特撮好きの仲間なんだよ！
records.en_original: And lastly, Kirara. She's a first-year like me—and a fellow tokusatsu fan!
records.en: And lastly, Kirara. She's a first-year like me—and a fellow tokusatsu fan!

records.jp: ようやくメンバー全員集まったね～。<CR>せっかくだし、このまま歓迎会でも……
records.en_original: Everyone's finally gathered! Since we're all here, why don't we have a little welcome party?
records.en: Everyone's finally gathered! Since we're all here, why don't we have a little welcome party?

records.jp: 勝手に決めないで！
records.en_original: Don't just decide that on your own!
records.en: Don't just decide that on your own!

records.jp: 司令に言われて来てみれば……冗談じゃない。<CR>なんで男の下で命懸けなきゃなんないのよ
records.en_original: The commander tells me to come here and this is what I get. What a joke. Why should I risk my life taking orders from a guy?
records.en: The commander tells me to come here and this is what I get. What a joke. Why should I risk my life taking orders from a guy?

records.jp: おい、菜々花
records.en_original: C'mon, Nanaka...
records.en: C'mon, Nanaka...

records.jp: とにかく！　わたしは男なんて絶対認めないから
records.en_original: Anyway! I'll never acknowledge a boy being in charge, got it?
records.en: Anyway! I'll never acknowledge a boy being in charge, got it?

records.jp: もう用はないでしょ？<CR>わたし、やることがあるから
records.en_original: We're done here, right? I've got things to do.
records.en: We're done here, right? I've got things to do.

records.jp: あっ、なーな……
records.en_original: Ah, Nana—
records.en: Ah, Nana—

records.jp: あ、あの、わたしの挨拶……
records.en_original: Um, excuse me, I haven't introduced myself...
records.en: Um, excuse me, I haven't introduced myself...

records.jp: また今度だねぇ
records.en_original: Let's save it for next time, okay?
records.en: Let's save it for next time, okay?

records.jp: 転校生が来るとは聞いてたけど、<CR>まさか男の人も一緒だったとは
records.en_original: I heard we were getting a new transfer student, but I never expected a boy to come along with her.
records.en: I heard we were getting a new transfer student, but I never expected a boy to come along with her.

records.jp: 春日詩帆、新入りです。<CR>よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: I'm Shiho Kasuga, the new girl. Nice to meet you.
records.en: I'm Kasuga Shiho, the new girl. Nice to meet you.

records.jp: 森崎・アレシア・優よ。<CR>よろしく
records.en_original: I'm Yu Alesia Morisaki. Nice to meet you.
records.en: I'm Morisaki Alesia Yu. Nice to meet you.

records.jp: 久野きらら。<CR>こちらこそ
records.en_original: I'm Kirara Kuno. Likewise.
records.en: I'm Kuno Kirara. Likewise.

records.jp: あの、森崎さん。<CR>先生から話を伺ったんですが、わたし……
records.en_original: Um, Alesia? I heard something from the teacher, but I...
records.en: Um, Morisaki-san? I heard something from the teacher, but I...

records.jp: ええ。私のバディになってくれるのよね？<CR>ちゃんと聞いてる
records.en_original: Yeah. You're going to be my partner, right? I heard all about it.
records.en: Yeah. You're going to be my partner, right? I heard all about it.

records.jp: バディがいないと出動できなかったから、<CR>転校してきてくれて嬉しいわ
records.en_original: I couldn't go on missions without a partner, so I'm really glad you transferred here.
records.en: I couldn't go on missions without a partner, so I'm really glad you transferred here.

records.jp: 「今までバディはいなかったのか？」
records.en_original: You didn't have a partner until now?
records.en: You didn't have a partner until now?

records.jp: 先生から聞いた話だと、少し前までは<CR>倉持亜美さんっていう人がいたらしいです
records.en_original: From what the teacher said, her partner was someone named Ami Kuramochi until not too long ago.
records.en: From what the teacher said, her partner was someone named Kuramochi Ami-san until not too long ago.

records.jp: けど、わたしたちとほとんど入れ違いに近い形で、<CR>伊勢校に転校したみたいです
records.en_original: But it sounds like she transferred to Ise High right before we got here, pretty much at the same time.
records.en: But it sounds like she transferred to Ise High right before we got here, pretty much at the same time.

records.jp: あ、あれ？　皆さん、どうかしたんですか？
records.en_original: H-huh? Is something wrong, everyone?
records.en: H-huh? Is something wrong, everyone?

records.jp: 詩帆
records.en_original: Shiho.
records.en: Shiho.

records.jp: は、はいっ！
records.en_original: Y-yes?
records.en: Y-yes?

records.jp: 伊勢校への転校というのは、殉職の隠語。<CR>つまり、亜美は死んだということ
records.en_original: Transferring to Ise High is actually code for "killed in the line of duty." In other words, Ami is dead.
records.en: Transferring to Ise High is actually code for "killed in the line of duty." In other words, Ami is dead.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: ……誰も教えてあげないのは、どうかと思う。<CR>それじゃ
records.en_original: ...I thought someone should tell you. Anyway, see you.
records.en: ...I thought someone should tell you. Anyway, see you.

records.jp: 殉職……し、死んだって……。<CR>任務で、ってこと、ですか？
records.en_original: Killed in the line... She...died? You mean, on a mission?
records.en: Killed in the line... She...died? You mean, on a mission?

records.jp: み、皆さん知ってたんですか！？<CR>こんな、だって、任務で殉職、なんて……
records.en_original: Did—did you all know about this?! I mean, killed in the line of duty, that's just...
records.en: Did—did you all know about this?! I mean, killed in the line of duty, that's just...

records.jp: 森崎さんだって、なんであんな平然と――！！
records.en_original: And Alesia too! How could she act so calm?!
records.en: And Morisaki-san too! How could she act so calm?!

records.jp: アレシアは……あの子は、少し特殊だから
records.en_original: Alesia is...she's a bit different from the rest of us.
records.en: Alesia is...she's a bit different from the rest of us.

records.jp: 私たちが平然と振る舞うのは、<CR>そうしないとやっていけないからだよ
records.en_original: We only act calm because that's the only way we can get by.
records.en: We only act calm because that's the only way we can get by.

records.jp: 灰が降って、死が身近になった。<CR>私たちの生き方は大きく変わってしまった
records.en_original: Ever since the Ash started falling and death became part of life, our whole way of living has changed.
records.en: Ever since the Ash started falling and death became part of life, our whole way of living has changed.

records.jp: でも、だからこそ、任務以外の時は<CR>日常に戻らないと。じゃないと――
records.en_original: But that's exactly why, when we're not on duty, we have to return to normal life. Otherwise—
records.en: But that's exactly why, when we're not on duty, we have to return to normal life. Otherwise—

records.jp: “戻ってこれなくなる”
records.en_original: You might never come back.
records.en: You might never come back.
